observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging (box) for a Century brand rechargeable mist fan.
The model number QRF-7116R is clearly printed on the box.
The box lists features including an 18-inch fan size, LED light, remote control, and mist/spray function.
The actual fan is not visible in the photo; only the box is shown.
The box is placed on a concrete floor, suggesting a storage or retail environment.

claims.evidence: The box shows a '12V 4.5Ah Battery' icon but does not explicitly state the quantity of batteries included.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, damaged, or incomplete item.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual fan outside of the box.

risks.risk: The internal rechargeable battery may be dead or have significantly reduced capacity.
risks.proof: Video of the fan running on battery power alone for several minutes.

risks.risk: The misting/spray mechanism may be clogged or the pump may be non-functional.
risks.proof: Video showing the mist function actively spraying.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard standing fan without misting capability

proof_requests: Photo of the actual fan out of the box to confirm condition and presence.
Video of the fan operating on battery power.
Video demonstrating the misting/spray function working.
Photo of the remote control and any included accessories.
response.reason: Only the retail box is shown. In the second-hand market, a photo of the box is not proof of the item's existence, condition, or functionality.
